candidate_pages.title: Mausoleum of Attar of Nishapur
candidate_pages.extract: A mausoleum of the poet Attar in Nishapur, in a garden, with an octagonal structure and multiple entrances.

candidate_pages.title: Mausoleum of Kamal-ol-Molk
candidate_pages.extract: The mausoleum of painter Kamal-ol-Molk is near the tomb of Attar and was designed by Hooshang Seyhoun.

candidate_pages.title: Shadiyakh
candidate_pages.extract: Shadiyakh was a medieval neighbourhood and archaeological site of Nishapur where excavations uncovered buildings and objects.
